description: Impianti autorizzati al trattamento rifiuti e produzione biogas biometano is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provincia.rovigo.it. Mapping of plants authorized by the Province of Rovigo for the treatment of waste and the production of biogas and biomethane. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Plants authorised for waste treatment and biogas production biomethane" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OPENDATA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
